identification: Large hardwood multi-drawer workshop counter/cupboard, 210cm wide, about 8 of 12 drawers present, worn

entries.note: Vintage Rota metal 16-drawer workshop cabinet, best offer; metal not timber, category guide only

viewing_check: Check species and joinery (dovetails), top thickness, whether the drawers and runners work, number of missing drawers, and whether it can be moved in pieces. Size makes it local-pickup only.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold (Australia only): industrial timber workshop cabinet multi drawer hardwood vintage; vintage shop counter drawers pigeonhole timber. No comparable large timber workshop units found; results were small or metal items.

identification: Goldstein Rapid Fry twin-pan 4-basket electric deep fryer on castors, model IRF24D, likely 3-phase
viewing_check: Read the compliance plate for model, voltage and phase (3-phase suits few buyers), check elements, thermostats and pan condition, and that castors work. Prospect is a trade buyer; check the bank of 4 baskets is complete.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: goldstein electric fryer; goldstein fryer (only Ninja and Devanti new items). No Goldstein sold. Existing Gowans sales of $100 and $46 stand.

identification: About 180 lm of Tasmanian oak architrave (90 lm 65mm, 90 lm 85mm), strapped packs, appears unused
viewing_check: Check lengths and count of packs, profile (bullnose or ogee), any moisture damage or end splits, and whether it is finger-jointed or solid.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: tasmanian oak architrave. Only UK-style solid oak architrave sets from retailers and unrelated items; no comparable. Not done: Gumtree or Bunnings price (new retail would be an ASKING reference only).

identification: Two-tier cast iron garden fountain ~150cm, probably modern Victorian-style reproduction.
viewing_check: Check for foundry marks, basin cracks/rust-through, whether pump and pipework present, weight/loading.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold x2 (cast iron 2 tier garden fountain; tiered fountain cast iron garden large): 0 relevant sold fountains (results were brackets, urns, frogs). Nothing found.

identification: Pack ~14 sqm Tasmanian oak T&G lining on pallet, appears new.
viewing_check: Confirm profile/thickness and grade, count lengths, check for moisture/warp.
searches_tried: Gumtree AU search for tasmanian oak T&G: zero results returned. eBay not tried (local pickup timber not sold there). Nothing found.

identification: Cream-painted cast/wrought iron child's cot ~90x118cm with brass finials, Victorian style, unmarked.

entries.note: 4 solid brass bed knobs / cot bed finials (parts only); finials only, not a cot; category guide at best

viewing_check: Photograph any maker plates, check welds/repairs, base slats, paint condition, size vs a genuine dolls cot.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: antique iron child cot brass finials (no cots in results; only finials/knobs). 2 later searches (dolls bed) hit eBay error pages. Nothing found for complete cots.

identification: Ottobock B600 power wheelchair, charger, no batteries, untested.

entries.note: Electric wheelchair ottobock b400 seat tilt actuator motor ram; B400 spare part (actuator), not a whole chair; category guide
Electric wheelchair used (unspecified model); model unknown, probably working chair; not comparable

viewing_check: Check frame/tilt actuators, controller and joystick, seat condition, tyres; no batteries so power-up untestable.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold x1 (otto bock b600 wheelchair): no whole B600 sold; second search errored (eBay error page). Found-so-far Armitage prices A$40-280 remain the best evidence.

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'nissan NDG5B diesel generator' (0), 'nissan diesel generator NDG' (0; only unrelated alternators/Onan pump parts). No Nissan diesel generator sales on eBay AU.

identification: Leitner step-over e-bike with helmet, charger, battery (per cloud research; photos not re-viewed)
viewing_check: Battery condition and whether it holds charge, charger fits, key present, motor engages, tyres/brakes.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'leitner electric bike' (0 exact; fallback results were new generic Chinese e-bikes A$530-1,300, not comparable).

identification: Five large blue VOLVO dealership letters, about 53cm high (per cloud research; photo not re-viewed)
viewing_check: Material (metal/acrylic), mounting studs, illumination wiring, whether all 5 letters are present and match.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'volvo letters sign' (21 results, all car badges/emblems or small signs; nothing at dealership scale; closest large item was an old porcelain 10-inch LUBE SERVICE letters set A$728, unrelated brand). Two earlier searches errored (eBay error page) and were retried.

identification: Unbranded green painted floor-standing vertical band saw (approx 14-16 inch), steel base, tilting table; no maker visible.

entries.note: 'Green Floor-Standing Corded Electric Band Saw with Table - Used', Best Offer format; size, maker and condition not verified, so similar type only

viewing_check: Look for maker plate and motor rating, check motor runs, wheels, table tilt and guides, blade length note, and plug/wiring safety.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'cast iron band saw floor standing'; 'vintage band saw 14 inch wood electric' (only parts and manuals).

identification: Red-painted cast iron flywheel-driven pump marked 'The Goulds Mfg Co', gold lining, repainted, 92 cm; early 20th century.
viewing_check: Check for model/No. cast on the body, seized or cracked castings, flywheel intact, missing parts, and whether the paint is hiding repairs. Existing Gowans Hobart hammer results A$110-330 (Apr and Oct 2026) remain the best local guide.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'Goulds antique pump' (only catalogues, manuals, modern pumps, hand pumps; no flywheel No.3 Royal pump). Two other query attempts errored.

identification: Pair of cast iron lattice basket-weave planters with ropework rim, white paint over rust, scroll feet, ~36 cm, no foundry mark visible.
viewing_check: Check for cracks and old welds (a visible crack runs down the right planter base), foundry marks underneath, drainage holes, and whether they are a true matched pair. Prior Armitage results (A$130-850) remain the guide.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: 'cast iron planters' (252 results; mostly small US urns and Mr Peanut banks, nothing lattice basket pair). Other queries errored (eBay error page).
